_howto: Elections polled by the Tally ENR / TotalResults adapter (server/src/adapters/tallyenr.js). cid = the client slug (https://{cid}.tally-enr.com); electionId from {base}/Election/GetElectionList?cid={cid}. contestTypes = which Tally contest types to read (each contest's contestTypeCode); measures are statewide only when their type is in statewideTypes. Set enabled:false to stop polling. Never use the multi-MB FullDataFile.json.
